extraction.name: CIFAR-10
extraction.description: A labeled subset of the 80 million tiny images dataset consisting of ten classes of objects with 6000 images in each class.
extraction.creator: Alex Krizhevsky
extraction.citeAs: Krizhevsky, A. (2009). Learning Multiple Layers of Features from Tiny Images.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Colleagues at MIT and NYU collected a dataset of millions of tiny colour images from the web by searching for images of every non-abstract English noun in WordNet using several search engines (Google, Flickr, AltaVista), keeping roughly the first 3000 results per term. Duplicates and images with excessive white pixels were removed.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: 80 million colour images downscaled to 32x32 from the web.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionTimeframe: over the span of six months
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Images were downscaled to 32x32. Perfect duplicates and images with an excessively large portion of white pixels were removed.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: ZCA whitening transformation was applied. The 1000 least significant principal components were deleted (set to zero in the diagonal matrix D).
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Paid students were given a class and asked to examine images found with that class as a search term (and its hyponyms in WordNet). Labelers were instructed to reject images that did not belong to the assigned class based on criteria: class name should be high on the list of likely answers, image should be photo-realistic (reject line drawings), image should contain only one prominent instance, object may be partially occluded or seen from an unusual viewpoint. Authors personally verified every label. Duplicate images were removed using L2 norm comparison.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Authors personally verified every label submitted by the labelers.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The search term used to find an image provides it with a rough label, although it is extremely unreliable due to the nature of online image search technology.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The tiny images dataset has no reliable class labels which makes it hard to use for object recognition experiments. The search term labels are extremely unreliable.
